findings.text: follow-on: the placement resolves a host by `record.host.split(".", 1)[0].lower()` compared against `server.host.split(".", 1)[0].lower()`, where imas_ambix/agent/registry.py:52 already maps every spelling of a declared server onto its name through `_short_host`; with a declaration host `98dci4-gpu-0004` and a registration host spelled `gpu-0004` (the short spelling the document path explicitly accepts -- executing `_server_index` on the reviewed tree returns {'b300': 'b300', '98dci4-gpu-0004': 'b300', 'gpu-0004': 'b300'}) the document groups the engine under the declared server while `_placement_of_running_serve` returns None, so the replacement falls back to `declared_servers[0]` -- the exact move imas_ambix/agent/slurm.py:520 performs and this commit exists to prevent, on any site declaring two servers.

follow-on: the placement read in `key_command` is the second of the two call sites this commit adds and no test exercises it, so the fragment's claim (docs/evidence/fragments/serving-across-servers/servers-declared-once.html:26-35) that `agent key --rotate` carries the running serve's placement is unguarded; only the `restart` path is measured.
